description: Binary-space-partition a polygon into cells — a pure CALCULATION node: coordinates in, coordinates out. Draws nothing on canvas.
instructions:
A value-only node: it takes a polygon as a coordinate LIST and returns its BSP cells as a coordinate list. It has no geometry input or output and draws nothing on the canvas or in 3D — wire val-polygons into a Polygon node when you want the cells drawn.

INPUT: polygon takes the outline as JSON [[x,y],...] metre pairs, local to the anchor. Wire Space Geometry val-points into valin-polygon.

OUTPUT: val-graph publishes the PARTITION NETWORK as { "nodes": [{ "id", "x", "y" }, ...], "edges": [{ "from_node_id", "to_node_id", "length" }, ...] } — one edge per cell boundary, deduped so a wall shared by two cells appears once, split at T-junctions. Edges carry NO thickness (BSP is partition-only) — apply wall thickness downstream with a Set Thickness node. Wire it into a Network node to draw the partition, or into a graph value node to process it.

val-polygons publishes every cell as a nested [[[x,y],...],...] list, which a Polygon node accepts directly.

PARTITION: seeds = target cell count; layout / balance / weights / tiltAngle / maxRatio / useConnection shape the split. Every parameter is wireable (valin-*).
